## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks before the Landau fan

Raw traces below show the hardwired B_1–B_2 longitudinal resistance using the **measured** drain current, plus drain and gate-current checks. Run 6 sweeps the electron side at nominal region-A n = +3.2×10¹² cm⁻², D≈0, from 0→10 T; run 7 rides down 10→0.3 T on the hole side at n = −1.2×10¹². Both are complete. The run-5 ridge ratio sets the relative gate path; the absolute n scale still inherits the 9.5 nm top-hBN geometry prior. The two CNP ridges imply series regions with ≈0.43×10¹² cm⁻² offset, so one Rxx trace is a mixture.

from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, sdh_onset, sdh_fft
from scipy.signal import find_peaks

fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(11, 7))
for rid, side in [(6, "electron"), (7, "hole")]:
    r = run(rid)
    ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col("magnet_field")
    I = r.col("sr0_X") / ch["sr0"].gain
    R = np.abs((r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain) / I)
    order = np.argsort(B)
    ax[0, 0].plot(B[order], R[order], lw=0.8, label=f"{rid} {side}")
    ax[0, 1].plot(B[order], I[order] * 1e9, lw=0.8, label=f"{rid} {side}")
    ax[1, 0].plot(B[order], r.col("k_2400_tg_curr")[order]*1e12, lw=0.8, label=f"{rid} TG")
    ax[1, 1].plot(B[order], r.col("k_2400_bg_curr")[order]*1e12, lw=0.8, label=f"{rid} BG")
    print(f"data/{rid}: {r.rows} points, {(r.meta['end_time']-r.meta['start_time'])/60:.1f} min, "
          f"B {B[0]:.2f}→{B[-1]:.2f} T, R {np.nanmin(R):.1f}…{np.nanmax(R):.1f} Ω, "
          f"I_drain {np.nanmin(I)*1e9:.3f}…{np.nanmax(I)*1e9:.3f} nA, "
          f"T {np.nanmin(r.col('T_sample')):.3f}…{np.nanmax(r.col('T_sample')):.3f} K, "
          f"interrupted={r.interrupted}")
for a, yl in zip(ax.flat, ["|Rxx| (Ω)", "I_drain (nA)", "I_TG (pA)", "I_BG (pA)"]):
    a.set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel=yl); a.legend(fontsize=7)
fig.suptitle("Raw run-6/7 spot traces; measured-current resistance")
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4))
for j, rid in enumerate((6, 7)):
    r = run(rid); ch = {c.cid:c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); I = r.col("sr0_X")/ch["sr0"].gain
    R = np.abs((r.col("sr1_X")/ch["sr1"].gain)/I)
    order = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[order], R[order]
    onset = sdh_onset(R, B, b_lo=0.3, b_hi=10, r_full_scale=10000)
    print(f"\ndata/{rid}: {onset.summary()}")
    f, spec = sdh_fft(R[:,None], B, b_range=(1.5, 10), nfft=2048, bg_degree=5, log=False)
    pk, _ = find_peaks(spec[0]); pk = sorted((p for p in pk if 2 < f[p] < 80), key=lambda p:spec[0,p], reverse=True)[:5]
    print("FFT peaks 1.5–10 T (T):", [round(float(f[p]),1) for p in pk])
    ax[j].plot(f, spec[0]); ax[j].set(xlim=(0,75), xlabel="SdH frequency (T)", ylabel="FFT amplitude (arb.)", title=f"data/{rid}: 1.5–10 T")
    for p in pk[:3]: ax[j].axvline(f[p], color="k", ls=":", alpha=.35)
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

**Take for Step 4:** Both spots oscillate with stable ≈9.8–9.9 nA drain current and sub-nA TG/BG readings (data/6–7). At +3.2×10¹² cm⁻² the electron run shows a ≈7.1 T low-frequency component plus ≈22–30 T structure; the latter could be a second pocket or harmonics of ≈7 T, and the series-region offset can add a second sequence. The hole run has ≈5–12 T components but is close to the accessible-density edge, so it is supporting context only. A B-slow, n-fast fan along the calibrated D≈0 line will test whether the higher-frequency features trace independent filling lines and whether branches originate at either CNP. No stacking label follows from these spot FFTs alone.

## HERA — Step 4: electron-side Landau fan (`landau-fan`)

> **05:23** · Landau fan: B slow 0→10 T, 41×0.25 T; D≈0 n\_A fast +0.8→+3.2e12 cm^-2, 61×0.04; Si 0, base T, sr1 100 µV · **ETA ~09:03** (≈3h40m)

Plan step 4, after data/5 calibrated the main CNP ridge and data/6–7 established strong SdH signal. Run 6 has a ≈7.1 T component and ≈22–30 T structure at nominal n_A=+3.2×10¹² cm⁻²; harmonics and the second CNP ridge (offset ≈0.43×10¹²) can mimic a second pocket. This fan varies density at D≈0 to see whether distinct Landau branches disperse independently and where they meet B=0. B is the slow axis, ascending from its handoff position ≈0 to 10 T; TG/BG co-sweep the run-5 calibrated D=0 line, n_A=+0.8…+3.2×10¹² cm⁻². The absolute density scale retains the top-hBN geometry prior; branch spacing and intercepts will be compared with the two measured CNP ridges.

**Coverage trade:** n_A<+0.8×10¹² is excluded because the series region B approaches its CNP there; a high-field gap may exceed the fixed 100 µV Rxx sensitivity (≈10 kΩ at 10 nA). The hole side is excluded from this fan because run 7's limited |n| and ≈8 K electron floor make its band test weaker; it remains in the ana record. 0.25 T B spacing and 0.04×10¹² density spacing target the 2–10 T filling sequences. The magnet traverse alone costs 10/0.137 ≈73 min; 2501 points at 2.3 s settle plus dual-gate writes/readbacks, row flyback and measured run-5 overhead bring the realistic runtime near the quoted ETA.

Preflight: live sample and vaporizer logfiles, base T, B≈0, Si=0 on RNGE 2/output on, heater ranges off, magnet output/persistent-switch heater on, lock-in drive/τ and committed validators. The cell sets its own TG/BG and Rxx sensitivity, then records both gate currents, measured drain current, Rxx X/P, and both temperatures. **Checkpoint:** inspect the first 2–3 complete rows for rail, leakage, drain-current failure and actual field tracking; then inspect at roughly 2, 5 and 8 T and interrupt for a sustained rail/leak or a flat channel. The cell also trips automatically on persistent >1 nA gate current or >90% Rxx full scale. A checkpoint wash-out saves the remaining ramp; any interrupt leaves the magnet at its current field, which must be read before another move. End state if complete: B=10 T, gates at n_A=+3.2×10¹², Si=0.

# === Landau fan: B slow 0→10 T, n_A fast +0.8→+3.2e12 cm^-2 along D=0 ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# Run-5 ridge-A calibration: ratio/offset data constrained; absolute capacitance = geometry prior.
CAL_FAN = dict(c_tg=2.7960593093052633e-3, c_bg=2.160696465377614e-3,
               n_offset=-0.08937933224099137, D_offset=-0.013)

# Load-bearing preconditions: state this cell assumes and never sets.
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
assert_thermometry_live("T_vaporizer", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_vaporizer"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_Ts, _Tv, _B, _Si = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field(), k_si()
_sr, _vr = heater.sample_range(), heater.vaporizer_range()
_dc_range, _dc_out = dc205.voltage_range(), dc205.output()
_ps, _out = magnet.persistent_switch_on(), magnet.output_enabled()
_drive, _freq, _tau, _slope = sr1.amplitude(), sr1.frequency(), sr1.time_constant(), sr1.filter_slope()
print(f"precondition T_sample={_Ts:.3f} K (1.0–1.5), T_vaporizer={_Tv:.3f} K (<1.6), "
      f"B={_B:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05), Si={_Si:+.4f} V (0); heater ranges sample/vap={_sr}/{_vr} (0/0)")
print(f"precondition magnet PS/output={_ps}/{_out} (True/True), DC205 range/output={_dc_range}/{_dc_out} (2/1); "
      f"drive={_drive:.3f} V at {_freq:.3f} Hz (1 V,13.777 Hz), tau={_tau:.3f} s slope={_slope} dB/oct (0.3,24)")
assert 1.0 <= _Ts <= 1.5 and _Tv < 1.6 and abs(_B) < 0.05 and abs(_Si) < 0.01
assert _sr == 0 and _vr == 0 and _ps and _out and _dc_range == 2 and _dc_out == 1
assert abs(_drive-1.0) < 0.01 and abs(_freq-13.777) < 0.01 and _tau <= 0.3 and _slope == 24
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
_vrange = lambda p: (float(p.vals._min_value), float(p.vals._max_value))
assert _vrange(k_tg.volt) == (-0.3, 1.0) and _vrange(k_bg.volt) == (-1.3, 2.0)
assert _vrange(dc205.smart_voltage) == (-25.0, 25.0) and _vrange(dc205.voltage) == (-25.0, 25.0)
assert _vrange(magnet.field) == (-10.0, 10.0) and B_SESSION_CAP == 10.0

n_fast = np.linspace(0.8, 3.2, 61)  # 10^12 cm^-2; A-region nominal
D_fast = np.zeros_like(n_fast)
Vtg_fast, Vbg_fast = calc_gate_voltages(n_fast, D_fast, **CAL_FAN)
n_check, D_check = calc_nD(Vtg_fast, Vbg_fast, **CAL_FAN)
B_slow = np.linspace(0.0, 10.0, 41)
assert np.max(np.abs(n_check-n_fast)) < 1e-9 and np.max(np.abs(D_check)) < 1e-9
assert np.min(Vtg_fast) >= TG_MIN and np.max(Vtg_fast) <= TG_MAX
assert np.min(Vbg_fast) >= BG_MIN and np.max(Vbg_fast) <= BG_MAX
assert B_slow.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
print(f"fan grid {len(B_slow)} B rows × {len(n_fast)} density pts = {len(B_slow)*len(n_fast)}; "
      f"B {B_slow[0]:.2f}→{B_slow[-1]:.2f} T, n_A {n_fast[0]:.2f}→{n_fast[-1]:.2f}e12 at D≈0; "
      f"TG {Vtg_fast[0]:+.4f}→{Vtg_fast[-1]:+.4f} V, BG {Vbg_fast[0]:+.4f}→{Vbg_fast[-1]:+.4f} V")

FAST_DELAY = 2.3  # >=7.7 tau for the 24 dB/oct Rxx lock-in
I_TRIP = 1e-9
RAIL_FRAC = 0.90
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)  # ~10 kΩ full scale at nominal 10 nA bias
print(f"sr1 sensitivity={sr1.sensitivity():.2e} V, sr0 sensitivity={sr0.sensitivity():.2e} V, "
      f"fast settle={FAST_DELAY:.1f} s; bare B-ramp floor={10/(1/7.3):.1f} min")

mc = dict(meas_config)
mc["Si (V)"] = _Si; mc["sample_temperature:"] = _Ts
mc["comments"] = ("landau-fan electron: run-5 A calibration, D=0, n_A 0.8..3.2e12 (61 × 0.04), "
                  "B 0..10 T (41 × 0.25), sr1 100 uV, fast_delay 2.3 s, Si 0")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f"electron n_A +0.8..+3.2e12 cm^-2 in 0.04 steps at D=0; B 0..10 T in 0.25 steps; "
              f"TG {Vtg_fast[0]:+.4f}..{Vtg_fast[-1]:+.4f} V, BG {Vbg_fast[0]:+.4f}..{Vbg_fast[-1]:+.4f} V; "
              f"run-5 c_bg/c_tg={CAL_FAN['c_bg']/CAL_FAN['c_tg']:.3f}, "
              f"n_offset={CAL_FAN['n_offset']:+.3f}e12, D_offset={CAL_FAN['D_offset']:+.3f} V/nm; Si=0, T=base")
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, float(Vbg_fast[0])); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, float(Vtg_fast[0]))
interruptible_sleep(10)

# Layout: time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, T_vaporizer, I_tg, I_bg, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P.
s.fp(T_sample).fp(T_vaporizer).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, k_tg.volt, sr1.X)
s.plot('time', T_sample); s.plot('time', T_vaporizer)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)
s.plot('time', sr0.X); s.plot('time', sr0.P)
s.plot('time', sr1.X); s.plot('time', sr1.P)

_bad = {"leak": 0, "rail": 0}
def guard(station, data):
    _bad["leak"] = _bad["leak"] + 1 if max(abs(float(data[6])), abs(float(data[7]))) > I_TRIP else 0
    _bad["rail"] = _bad["rail"] + 1 if abs(float(data[10])) > RAIL_FRAC * 100e-6 else 0
    if _bad["leak"] >= 3 or _bad["rail"] >= 3:
        print(f"FAN TRIP at B={float(data[1]):.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f} V: "
              f"I_tg={float(data[6]):+.2e} A, I_bg={float(data[7]):+.2e} A, sr1.X={float(data[10]):+.2e} V; "
              f"leak/rail consecutive={_bad['leak']}/{_bad['rail']}")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(guard, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_slow], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_fast, Vbg_fast],
                 slow_delay=0, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
print(f"fan done: measured B={magnet.field():+.4f} T, TG={k_tg.volt():+.4f} V, "
      f"BG={k_bg.volt():+.4f} V, Si={k_si():+.4f} V, T_sample={T_sample():.3f} K")

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)
